# Project Context (LLM-optimized)

## Directives
- GRAPH-FIRST: explore code via `specd graph`; grep/glob only non-code or last resort. Stale/missing graph → `specd graph index`.
- `specs/` = requirements SoT; never edit directly. Workflow: draft → implement → review → approve → merge → archive. No code without spec; read/update existing specs; avoid duplicates.
- Artifacts, code, comments, docs English. Full spec: `specd specs context <id>`; include globals with `default:*`.
- TypeScript pnpm ESM monorepo. Hexagonal+DDD: domain no I/O; application ports; infrastructure adapters; rich entities enforce invariants; pure stateless services; manual DI.

## Global Specs — load full via `specd specs context <id>`

### default:_global/architecture
- Business packages: domain → application → infrastructure; inner layers never import outer. Domain no I/O; application uses ports; infrastructure excludes composition.
- Entities own invariants/typed transition errors; value objects expose behavior; stateless domain services are exported functions.
- Ports abstract classes with explicit methods. Constructor DI; no IoC/singletons. Validate external YAML at infrastructure boundary; typed `SpecdError`.
- Composition alone imports infrastructure. `createKernel`, `createKernelBuilder`, capability factories share resolver; canonical `createX(deps)`. Public barrels exclude concrete adapters.
- Adapter packages contain no business logic. Dependencies: plugin-* → skills → core; cli/mcp → sdk; sdk → core|code-graph; schema-* standalone; no cycles. Cross core/graph hosts use `@specd/sdk`.

### default:_global/conventions
- Strict TypeScript; `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`, ESM NodeNext. Named exports; kebab-case; explicit public returns; no `any`; expected errors use `SpecdError`; immutable domain.

### default:_global/testing
- Vitest; test tree mirrors src; `.spec.ts`; Given/When/Then; no snapshots. Domain/application unit tests mock I/O. Integration uses unique `os.tmpdir()` dirs and cleanup. Ensure cross-platform paths, fixtures, line endings.

### default:_global/docs
- Docs only under `docs/{adr,cli,code-graph,core,guide,mcp,schemas,sdk,skills}`; exceptions: root README, AGENTS, CLAUDE.
- `docs/guide`: title/description/sidebar_position frontmatter; user usage only; configuration/workflows match core; begin with What is SpecD; cover skills, project update, plugins, graph. Keep SDK/package internals outside guide.
- ADR: sequential `NNNN-kebab-case`, MADR, Decision Outcome Confirmation + More Information/Spec; link source specs only.
- Every CLI command needs docs/cli page, index, sidebar; MCP schemas/examples in docs/mcp. Public symbols need full JSDoc.
- Hosts document/import `@specd/sdk` only. SDK collections under `docs/sdk/{core,code-graph,skills,schemas}` require frontmatter. Update affected docs for public composition, template/config cascades, list-contract changes.

### default:_global/eslint
- Type-aware TypeScript: forbid any/default exports; require explicit returns, kebab-case, JSDoc, layer boundaries. Lint before commit.

### default:_global/continuous-integration
- CI on macOS/Ubuntu/Windows for PR+main; pnpm 10.6.5, Node 22, frozen install; build → typecheck → test.

### default:_global/error-handling-conventions
- Expected user failures: `SpecdError`, `specd=true`, UPPER_SNAKE code, actionable message, JSON/TOON metadata.

### default:_global/logging
- Console-compatible `log/info/debug/warn/error`; info for normal events; fatal/trace through error/debug prefixes; abstraction over raw console.
